summary: Specifies an RTP payload format for generic forward error correction of media data, based on XOR parity. It supports different protection lengths, levels and group sizes to suit various media and networks. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Every few packets, send an extra packet that is a mix of the others. If one gets lost, the receiver can work it out from the mix.
